Key Advantages and Features of Electric Wire Rope Hoists # Electric wire rope hoists are essential lifting devices widely used across industries, construction sites, warehouses, and manufacturing facilities. They are designed to provide reliable vertical lifting and movement of heavy loads, ensuring efficiency and safety in material handling operations.
As a leading manufacturer in Taiwan, Cheng Day offers a comprehensive range of electric wire rope hoists tailored to address diverse lifting challenges. Below, we explore the core features and benefits that set these hoists apart.
Product Range # Cheng Day provides several models of electric wire rope hoists to accommodate various requirements:
Electric Wire Rope Hoist (AC brake) Electric Wire Rope Hoist (DC brake) Electric Wire Rope Hoist (USA type) Electric Wire Rope Hoist (PM series) Economy Wire Rope Crab Open Type Crab Trolley AC Brake - Electric Wire Rope Hoist DC Brake - Electric Wire Rope Hoist USA Type - Electric Wire Rope Hoist PM Series - Electric Wire Rope Hoist Economy Wire Rope Crab Open Type Crab Trolley Distinctive Features # Efficient Energy Absorption
Cheng Day electric wire rope hoists utilize intermediate intensity wire ropes. While these ropes are larger in dimension compared to high-intensity alternatives, they excel at absorbing energy during repetitive load impacts. This characteristic extends the fatigue life of the equipment, contributing to long-term durability.
Reduced Maintenance Costs
The larger contact area of the wire rope minimizes abrasion rates. Additionally, the wire ropes are easily sourced, further reducing maintenance expenses and downtime.
Enhanced Balance
The drum design houses both reducers and electric motors on opposite sides, with a drive shaft running through the drum for transmission. This configuration ensures optimal balance during operation and effectively addresses potential balance issues.
Superior Impact Resistance
The hoist frame is constructed using welded forming before processing, which provides greater impact resistance compared to traditional bolted joints.
Flexible Brake Options
Two brake types are available—AC and DC—allowing users to select the solution that best fits their specific requirements and market preferences.
Adaptable Trolley Adjustment
For hoists with smaller trolley gauges, the shaft for the traversing wheel can be adjusted according to height. This feature compensates for any camber variation between girders, ensuring all four wheels maintain consistent contact with the traversing rail.
Easy Component Procurement
Primary electrical components are sourced from reputable brands, ensuring ease of procurement and replacement.
Applications # Electric wire rope hoists are indispensable in material handling and lifting operations, offering a controlled and reliable means of moving heavy objects safely and efficiently.

Gearless Elevator Traction Machines: Modern PMSM Solutions # The Gearless Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) Elevator Traction Machine represents a significant advancement in elevator technology. Designed for efficiency, safety, and comfort, this machine integrates a permanent-magnet synchronous motor, traction wheel, and brake system, all managed through an encoder for precise closed-loop and frequency control operations.

Industrial Lifting Systems: Overhead, Gantry, and Jib Cranes # Cheng Day offers a versatile range of lifting solutions tailored for industrial environments, focusing on overhead cranes, bridge cranes, gantry cranes, jib cranes, and portal cranes. These systems are engineered to enhance efficiency, safety, and adaptability in manufacturing and maintenance settings.
Main Lifting Equipment Overview # Our primary lifting equipment includes:
Overhead Cranes Bridge Cranes (Bridge crane) Overhead Travelling Cranes (Overhead travelling cranes) Gantry Cranes (Gantry crane) Jib Cranes Portal Cranes The overhead bridge cranes are available in three distinct types—low speed, regular speed, and high speed—allowing for flexible application based on operational requirements. Jib and portal cranes are designed with integrated up/down hoisting and left/right traversing mechanisms, sometimes featuring both main and secondary hoisting units for added versatility.
The crab frame is constructed using structural steel with welded joints, ensuring durability and strength. The layout of the crab trolley is optimized for available space, facilitating easier maintenance and including safety features such as handrails.
Bridge Crane & EOT (Electric Overhead Traveling) Crane # Bridge cranes, also known as overhead cranes, feature a robust lifting system—either an overhead hoist or an open overhead winch. Their modular construction and high degree of standardization make them adaptable to a wide range of industrial applications. Key features include:
Parallel runways with a traveling bridge A hoist that moves along the bridge If the bridge is supported on legs running on ground-level rails, the system is referred to as a gantry crane (USA, ASME series) or goliath crane (UK, BS series). Unlike mobile or construction cranes, these systems are primarily used in manufacturing or maintenance, where operational efficiency and minimized downtime are critical.
Optimized Space Utilization # Cheng Day’s overhead cranes, including the Black Bear series, are designed to maximize usable space. The integration of lifting, cross travel, and long travel mechanisms reduces hook approaches, expanding the effective working area. Structural welded elements are produced using automated and robotic systems, ensuring consistent quality and repeatability.
Our cranes accommodate a broad range of lifting needs, from chain hoists with a 250 kg capacity to wire rope hoists capable of handling up to 200 tons. The structure—whether box girder or standard profile—is optimized through computer-aided calculations for maximum efficiency and reliability.
Technical Standards and References # Cheng Day’s designs adhere to internationally recognized standards, referencing:
CMAA (Crane Manufacturers Association of America) HMI (Hoist Manufacturers Institute) MMA (Monorail Manufacturers Association) FEM (European Materials Handling Federation) DIN (German Institute for Standardization) ISO (International Organization for Standardization) JIS (Japanese Industrial Standards) CE (European Conformity) These standards ensure our products meet stringent requirements for safety, reliability, and performance.

起重機產品常見疑問與專業解答 # 歡迎您蒞臨誠岱機械常見問題專區。本頁針對客戶在選購、使用及維修本公司產品時，經常遇到的疑問，提供詳盡解說，協助您更有效率地解決問題並了解產品專業知識。
疑難排解 # Q：額定荷重及吊昇荷重，如何區分？
A：
額定荷重指的是吊具本身可承載的最大能力。 吊昇荷重則包含吊具自重在內的總荷重。在高揚程應用時，還需將鋼索自重計入。 吊昇荷重是進行馬力計算的依據。 專業知識 # 1. 機械式安全剎車——第一段安全保護 # 齒輪箱內設有機械式安全剎車器，有效防止荷重物下落失速，保障操作人員安全。 剎車器主要零件包括： 剎車制止片 剎車來令片 剎車棘輪 剎車活動片 棘爪 棘輪摩擦片 採用專利無聲機械結構設計，運行時能抑制機械噪音。 2. 馬達直結式制動——第二段安全保護 # 馬達直結式剎車，採用交流(AC)電磁碟式剎車器。 剎車磁通面以8分隔與12分格式設計（每30°或60°），可平均產生磁器吸力。 磁器吸力設計以馬達各kW值扭矩的1.5倍安全係數配置不同剎車器。 斷電後殘磁性低，剎車動態響應度在100ms（0.1秒）內，並可達到ISO M8及FEM 5M等級，寸動最高可達360次/小時。 3. 鋼索溝表面粗糙度3.2a # 採用專業設計的銑刀式鋼索溝加工機及技術，使鋼索捲輪筒溝槽表面粗糙度達CNS 3.2a標準。 有效減少鋼索表面摩擦，延長鋼索壽命1.3倍以上。 4. 運轉噪音 # 運轉噪音控制於JEM 1313標準，感應電動機kW數的噪音水準值dB以內。 5. 機械結構 # 機械結構設計符合ISO M1M8及FEM 1DM5M等級，並符合CNS 4616及4617標準。 售後維修服務 # Q：我購買的產品如果有維修問題該如何處理？
A：
所有販售產品皆附帶保固服務，請安心使用。 若產品需維修，請於「聯絡我們」頁面詳細填寫問題與保固卡資訊。 若產品仍在保固期內，部分維修可免費提供。 收到您的訊息後，我們將主動聯繫並協助處理維修事宜。 產品瀏覽方式 # Q：怎樣瀏覽商品才是最迅速的？
A：
提供兩種快速瀏覽方式： 於「產品介紹」項目中逐層點選，直至找到所需產品。 於左側產品搜尋引擎輸入關鍵字，進行快速搜尋。
